note: 133Cs |3,+3>+|3,+3> (absolute ground state). a(B) of the channel is piecewise published fits: Kraemer et al. (0-150 G, the broad s-wave pole near -12 G with a field-dependent background; narrow d/g lines excluded and multiplied in from the list below) and Jachymski & Julienne (490-508, 530-570 and 750-900 G, fits to the M2012 coupled-channel a(B) of Berninger et al.). Between the fitted ranges a(B) is a global product model scaled to meet the fits (drawn dashed). The resonance list gives Berninger et al.'s measured poles and zero crossings (PRA 87, 032517 (2013)).
a_bg_ref: Kraemer et al., Nature 440, 315 (2006), Methods: a(B) = (1722 + 1.52 B/G)(1 - 28.72/(B/G + 11.74)) a0. (The earlier 2858 a0 was the triplet scattering length a_T, not the background of this channel.)
